summary.intent: Improve the summary TUI layout and add a checkpoint-specific view, then fix memory-loop refresh to scope backfill correctly to the target branch.
summary.outcome: Summary TUI layout was polished (spacing, nav width, detail pane alignment, scrollable detail with mouse), checkpoint prefix filtering was added to the summary command, and memory-loop refresh was fixed to backfill only sessions within the resolved scope before distilling memories.

repo: summarytui lives in cmd/entire/cli/summarytui/ with root.go, styles.go, detail_page.go, keys.go
Viewport sizing must happen in resize() with a pointer receiver, not inside View() which uses a value receiver — changes in View() are silently discarded
MouseWheelEnabled must be explicitly set to true on the bubbletea viewport; it does not default to true
backfillSummaries is in insights_cmd.go; backfillFacets is in improve_cmd.go — split across files

queryMemoryLoopRows for repo scope filters by checkpoint reachability from main (merged commits), not by the session's branch metadata field — so sessions from feature branches that merged to main are correctly included
resolveMemoryLoopScope produces a scope with Branch or OwnerID set, which queryMemoryLoopRows uses to filter

code.finding: verticalChrome constant must be incremented when adding blank lines to the filter bar area to keep viewport height calculation correct
Viewport is initialized in newRootModel and resized in resize(); renderDetailPane must not touch viewport dimensions since it has a value receiver
When a checkpoint prefix is provided, defaultBranch should be set to empty string so the TUI's filterRepo doesn't exclude sessions on non-default branches
Scope resolution must happen before backfill; original code ran backfill on global last-N sessions before scope was resolved, causing off-branch sessions to get summaries/facets generated
backfillSummaries was refactored to accept pre-queried rows (ForRows variant) to allow caller-controlled scoping
backfillFacets was refactored to accept pre-queried rows (ForRows variant) to allow caller-controlled scoping

workflow: git checkout -- <path> restores deleted files from the last commit without touching staged/unstaged modifications elsewhere
When many files are accidentally deleted, 'git checkout HEAD -- cmd/' restores the entire subtree at once
t.Parallel() and t.Chdir() cannot be combined in Go tests — the runtime panics
bubbletea mouse support requires both tea.WithMouseCellMotion() in program options AND MouseWheelEnabled=true on the viewport component

friction: User accidentally deleted multiple files mid-session, requiring all edits to be re-applied from scratch
The detail pane scroll didn't work because MouseWheelEnabled was never set — silent failure with no error
viewport size changes in View() with value receiver were silently discarded, causing incorrect height calculations
memory-loop refresh was backfilling wrong-branch sessions before scope was resolved — only caught by user observation, not tests
Test for backfill debug output broke after reorder because the test session had no OwnerID and was filtered out by the now-earlier scope resolution
open_items: The ineffassign lint warning on summary_cmd.go:184 is pre-existing and was not fixed — needs investigation
Arrow key navigation for left nav currently competes with viewport scroll; only mouse/trackpad scroll was added for detail pane — keyboard scrolling of detail pane not implemented
